player_prompt.intro:
D kečč imiraz {player_id} di **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Sekkelsen tajdect-ik am **[macro  micro]** (sin imḍanen 0-8):
• *macro*  = aya d tablirt n waddar i d-yalalen
• *micro* = aya d takat n waddar di tablirt n waddar
Amedya `[7 8]` ➜ ssekcem isem-ik di tablirt n waddar 7, takat 8, d
ḍmen ad d-yalalen wergaz-ik di tablirt n waddar 8 i d-yernan.

D kečč `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Asikel ilaq ad yili deg talɣa [macro micro] s uṭṭunen 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Iḍfaren ilaq yal yiwen ad yili gar 0 d 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Tafelwit, tazelɣa neɣ amyag ur d-yettili ara deg uzal.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Ilaq ad yurar umyurar deg usebter-nniḍen.

game_action.played: Ayalal {player_id} yalalen di tablirt n waddar {macro_idx}, takat {micro_idx} (ajgu {row}, takat {col}). Ayalal {opponent_id} ilaq ad d-yalalen di {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Amyurar {player_id} yerbeḥ Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
